messages:
jordan: Quick debrief from the apac egress noise yesterday. TL;DR: soft shields helped, but recurring pattern suggests we need a controlled experiment for fractional dedicated pools per region.
opsbot: incident note: 2025-06-01 09:11 UTC  degraded performance in slice apac-2 due to high egress->nvlink backpressure. Auto-shield invoked.
anya: agree we need to quantify impact before a wide rollout. Can we run a 48h experiment in apac-2 with 10% capacity carved as egress-dedicated? Need metrics to collect: tail latency, kv-regen-rate, cold-starts, egress-util per-tenant, and cost delta.
kevin: Sounds good. Quick thought on experiment knobs: 1) carve fraction (5/10/20%), 2) tenant admission filter (only long-tail checkpointers), 3) egress policer on non-dedicated slice.
jordan: proposed experiment plan in short: 
- Day 0: create fractional dedicated slice: `redwoodctl pool create --region apac-2 --size 10% --label egress-dedicated-exp1`
- Day 0: schedule traffic tagging for known heavy checkpoint tenants (tz-prod, ckp-batch).
- Day 1-2: collect p50/p95/p99 latency, kv-regen, cold-start-rate, egress bytes, and quarterly cost projection.
kevin: how do we want to account cost? if we reserve 10% dedicated capacity, that reduces available shared capacity and increases reserved spend. Rough calc: apac-2 monthly GPU cost ~ $1.2M, 10% -> $120k/mo. But 10% fractional reserved might be more efficient if it prevents evictions that cause extra token spend. Need a token-level cost delta estimate.
anya: I can mock token-cost delta: sample workload avg extra tokens from cold-starts was ~30k tokens/day per impacted tenant. Multiply by per-token cost to get monthly. But we need real numbers. I'll instrument a small eval harness.
docs-bot: Note: add runbook entry stub under docs/ops/egress-dedicated-experiments.md (created) 
jordan: experiment schedule: start 2025-06-03 01:00 UTC, 48h. Owner: anya. Rollback: auto-delete slice and policer after window. Success criteria: p99 latency drop >= 20% for impacted tenants OR cold-start reduction >= 50% with <5% net capacity loss for other tenants.
kevin: question: allocator changes vs dedicated pool. Can we do smarter placement first? e.g. add egress-score penalty to allocator so heavy egress tasks are co-located to specific racks before carving dedicated. Might be lower cost.
anya: yes but allocator change needs careful canary and longer rollout. Experiment gives us data to justify that investment. Also might reveal whether dedicated is a cheaper operational lever.
jordan: action items: anya -> create experiment PR + monitoring dashboard; kevin -> cost model sketch and sim; docs-bot -> runbook update; me -> draft RFC for "fractional egress-dedicated pools" to present Friday.
opsbot: scheduled action: create alert for egress-eviction-cascade in apac-2 if kv-regen > 300/s for 5m continuously.
kevin: I'll start cost sim today and post numbers by EOD. If sim shows >$30k/mo net benefit to customers from reduced token waste, we can move faster.
anya: I'll add instrumentation to trace cold-start token delta and tag flows by tenant. Quick command I'll use: `kquery traces "slice=apac-2 AND event=coldstart" | summarize tokens by tenant`
docs-bot: runbook note: include shield + policer commands, experiment template, and rollback checklist.
jordan: thanks all. Let's avoid big names in RFC title. Keep it pragmatic. Ping me if you see spike during the experiment window.
